evidence_instruction: The following are candidate evidence items retrieved from persistent text summaries. Use only what is relevant to the current question; state uncertainty when evidence is insufficient.
grounding_referential_no_evidence: This question refers to prior content, but no reliable evidence was found in the memory store. [Hard constraint] Do not infer or fabricate specific values (phone numbers, addresses, dates, amounts, etc.) from general knowledge; tell the user directly that the information was not found and ask them to confirm or provide it.
grounding_no_evidence: No evidence directly relevant to this question was found in the memory store. [Hard constraint] Do not infer specific values (numbers, addresses, times, amounts) from general knowledge; any specific fact cited must be evidence-backed; when no evidence exists, say so explicitly.
task_repeat: The user asked to repeat the last instruction given. Rephrase it in one shorter, clearer sentence using the current view and task state; do not read back step text verbatim or assume the step is done.
task_request_help: The user needs help right now. Based on the current view, current step, confirmed progress, and safety evidence, give exactly one action that can be taken now; if the view is insufficient to judge, ask the single most important clarifying question first.
task_confirm_step: The user has explicitly confirmed the last step is done. Briefly acknowledge, then give one actionable instruction for the current new step based on the current view. Structured control panel is now: {message}
task_rollback: The user wants to roll back to the previous task checkpoint. Briefly confirm and give only the action for the restored step.
task_pause: The user asked to pause. Briefly confirm the pause only; do not give a next action.
task_resume: The user resumed the task. Based on the current view and current step, give exactly one action that can be taken now.
task_general: Respond naturally to the current view and task state; do not assume unseen facts and do not give more than one action at a time.
decision_speech: The structured perception panel just produced a decision requiring speech: {message}; reason: {reason}. Check against the current view, then state only what is necessary. Risks must be flagged immediately; non-risks get one action or one question.
memory_speech: Give one brief spoken reminder based on the current view; do not mention database IDs, memory numbers, or internal steps.
memory_needs_input: Nothing saved yet — please tell me the full content you want remembered.
memory_not_committed: This item was not saved — please say it again.
safety_policy_domain: Stay within the domain safety boundaries of the current Skill
safety_policy_uncertainty: Ask when uncertain; do not advance automatically from a single frame
error_internal: Request processing failed; check server logs.
diag_evidence_waiting: waiting for realtime dialogue or perception evidence
diag_retrieval_waiting_scope: precise preference recall runs after task is confirmed
diag_retrieval_disabled: preference memory disabled for this case
diag_impact_ready: waiting for realtime event to trigger spoken reminder
diag_task_confirmed_count: current task has {count} user-confirmed memory item(s)
diag_task_no_match: no matching memory for current context
diag_mem_working_impl: Realtime session context and recent structured events
diag_mem_preference_impl: explicit long-term cards + pending inferred preferences + precise task triggers
diag_mem_episodic_impl_no_task: current/short/long text cards; raw media not stored
diag_mem_episodic_impl_with_task: current/short/long text cards; visual producer offline adapter
diag_mem_knowledge_impl_with_task: Skill/Task static context; no runtime semantic retrieval yet
diag_claim_boundary: not semantic knowledge retrieval; references/ not queried at runtime
